headlines.description: — Viktor Arvidsson scored the go-ahead goal on a breakaway 4:28 into the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday for their 12th straight home victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bruins beat Caps 3-1 for 12th straight home win

events.name: New York Rangers at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes had a hat trick and an assist, Nico Hischier scored the go-ahead goal, and the New Jersey Devils beat the New York Rangers 6-3 on Saturday for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes has a hat trick and an assist in the Devils’ 6-3 win over the Rangers

headlines.description: — Tage Thompson and Jason Zucker scored less than two minutes apart in the second period and the Buffalo Sabres held on to win their sixth game in a row, 3-2 over the Nashville Predators on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres beat the Predators 3-2 for their sixth straight win

headlines.description: — Trevor Zegras scored the only goal of the shootout to help the Philadelphia Flyers defeat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zegras scores in shootout as Flyers defeat Penguins 4-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov had three assists in a four-goal first period and added another in the third to give him 100 points on the season as the Tampa Bay Lightning cruised past the listless Toronto Maple Leafs 5-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikita Kucherov’s 4 assists power Lightning over slumping Maple Leafs 5-2

events.name: Utah Mammoth at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley scored his second goal of the game at 2:08 of overtime and the Utah Mammoth overcame Columbus’ tying third-period burst to beat the Blue Jackets 5-4 on Saturday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooley scores in OT to lift the Mammoth past the Blue Jackets, 5-4

headlines.description: — Josh Morrissey scored 1:49 into overtime to become the highest-scoring defenseman in franchise history, lifting the Winnipeg Jets to a 3-2 victory over the NHL-worst Vancouver Canucks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morrissey scores OT winner in return to set Jets' points mark for defensemen in 3-2 win over Canucks

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Juraj Slafkovsky scored his second goal 49 seconds before he set up captain Nick Suzuki for the tiebreaker with 4:33 to play, leading the Montreal Canadiens' rally for a 4-3 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juraj Slafkovsky, Nick Suzuki lead Canadiens' late comeback for a 4-3 win over the Kings

headlines.description: — Joel Farabee scored twice and had an assist to lead the Calgary Flames to a 5-4 victory over the Carolina Hurricanes on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Farabee scores 2 goals as Flames edge Hurricanes 5-4

events.name: New York Islanders at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat scored with 39.6 seconds left in overtime, lifting the New York Islanders to a 2-1 win over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Horvat scores winner in OT as Islanders edge Sharks 2-1

headlines.description: — Shane Pinto had a goal and two assists in Ottawa's four-goal spree in the first and second periods and the Senators beat the Seattle Kraken 7-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators pull away with 4-goal spree, beat Kraken 7-4
